list.name: test
list.label: Test (suite/file)
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT suite || '/' || test FROM codesize_func WHERE opt = 'o2' ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT suite || '/' || test FROM codesize_func WHERE opt = 'o2' ORDER BY 1

targets.queryText: SELECT r.commit_ts * 1000 AS time, c.profile AS metric, c.divergent_count AS value FROM correctness c JOIN runs r USING(run_id) WHERE c.oracle = 'olevels' ORDER BY time
SELECT r.commit_ts * 1000 AS time, SUM(c.divergent_count) AS value FROM correctness c JOIN runs r USING(run_id) GROUP BY r.run_id ORDER BY time

panels.title: Code size vs GCC (tcc/gcc ratio, <total>) by opt
panels.description: Total tcc/gcc instruction-count ratio over the whole corpus, one line per opt level (both compilers built at that level). Lower = closer to GCC.

targets.queryText: SELECT r.commit_ts * 1000 AS time, cr.opt AS metric, cr.ratio AS value FROM codesize_rollup cr JOIN runs r USING(run_id) WHERE cr.suite = '<total>' ORDER BY time

panels.title: Compile time (code-size corpus) by opt
panels.description: Wall time to compile the code-size corpus at each TCC opt level.

targets.queryText: SELECT r.commit_ts * 1000 AS time, replace(ct.scope, 'codesize_corpus_', '') AS metric, ct.seconds AS value FROM compile_time ct JOIN runs r USING(run_id) WHERE ct.scope LIKE 'codesize_corpus_o%' ORDER BY time
SELECT r.commit_ts * 1000 AS time, p.benchmark || ' (' || p.compiler || ')' AS metric, p.cycles_per_iter AS value FROM perf p JOIN runs r USING(run_id) WHERE p.opt_level = 'o2' ORDER BY time

SELECT r.commit_sha AS commit, r.subject AS subject, c.profile, c.oracle, c.divergent_count AS now, p.divergent_count AS parent, (c.divergent_count - p.divergent_count) AS delta FROM correctness c JOIN runs r USING(run_id) JOIN runs rp ON rp.commit_sha = r.parent_sha AND rp.host = r.host JOIN correctness p ON p.run_id = rp.run_id AND p.profile = c.profile AND p.oracle = c.oracle WHERE (c.divergent_count - p.divergent_count) > 0 ORDER BY delta DESC

panels.title: Code-size delta vs parent — per function (latest commit, $opt)
panels.description: Per-function instruction-count change between the newest recorded commit and its first parent, at the $opt level. Positive delta = grew (regression); ordered worst-first. Populated by record.py --codesize-detail.

targets.queryText: SELECT cf.suite, cf.test, cf.function, cf.tcc_size AS now, pf.tcc_size AS parent, (cf.tcc_size - pf.tcc_size) AS delta FROM codesize_func cf JOIN runs r USING(run_id) JOIN runs rp ON rp.commit_sha = r.parent_sha AND rp.host = r.host JOIN codesize_func pf ON pf.run_id = rp.run_id AND pf.suite = cf.suite AND pf.test = cf.test AND pf.function = cf.function AND pf.opt = cf.opt WHERE r.run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM runs ORDER BY commit_ts DESC LIMIT 1) AND cf.opt = '${opt}' AND cf.tcc_size <> pf.tcc_size ORDER BY delta DESC

panels.title: Worst tcc/gcc code-size ratio (latest commit, $opt, top 50)
panels.description: Functions where TinyCC emits the most instructions relative to GCC at the $opt level in the newest recorded commit. The standing 'where are we worst' list, independent of any regression.

targets.queryText: SELECT cf.suite, cf.test, cf.function, cf.tcc_size, cf.gcc_size, cf.ratio FROM codesize_func cf WHERE cf.run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM runs ORDER BY commit_ts DESC LIMIT 1) AND cf.opt = '${opt}' AND cf.gcc_size > 0 ORDER BY cf.ratio DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Code size over commits — $test (instructions, tcc vs gcc, $opt)
panels.description: History of the selected test's total instruction count (summed over its functions) at the $opt level, TinyCC vs GCC. Pick a test in the '$test' dropdown and an opt level in '$opt' at the top.

targets.queryText: SELECT r.commit_ts * 1000 AS time, 'tcc' AS metric, SUM(cf.tcc_size) AS value FROM codesize_func cf JOIN runs r USING(run_id) WHERE cf.suite || '/' || cf.test = '${test}' AND cf.opt = '${opt}' GROUP BY r.run_id UNION ALL SELECT r.commit_ts * 1000 AS time, 'gcc' AS metric, SUM(cf.gcc_size) AS value FROM codesize_func cf JOIN runs r USING(run_id) WHERE cf.suite || '/' || cf.test = '${test}' AND cf.opt = '${opt}' GROUP BY r.run_id ORDER BY time
